purpose: Phase-6D tumour growth-model architecture + normalized burden defaults. Supports the ARCHITECTURE for several growth models but activates none without evidence or an explicitly labelled prediction. The Profile-B default is ordinal / normalized schematic growth because no verified quantitative tumour curves are extracted in the frozen package.

ordinal_schematic.description: Normalized schematic growth driven by ordinal net-pressure classes; the Profile-B default.

exponential.description: Architecture only; requires an extracted growth constant (NOT_REPORTED).

logistic.description: Architecture only; requires an extracted carrying capacity + rate (NOT_REPORTED).

gompertz.description: Architecture only; requires extracted Gompertz parameters (NOT_REPORTED).

evidence_derived_curve.description: Architecture only; requires a primary-source numeric curve (NOT_REPORTED).

burden_defaults.note: baseline_burden = 1.0 is a simulation reference only; NOT a real tumour volume.
